reason: Last year at home it was cramped and I spent the whole day cleaning up. Here I get the room to ourselves, an entertainer and decorations, and I don't have to organise anything. I'd take EXTRA so the adults get coffee too. For a 5-year-old, a big hall in Gdańsk is overkill anyway.
objection: The add-ons pile up: every extra child, a second entertainer, café service for adults, and I'm not allowed to bring my own cake for the grown-ups. Something listed at 850 zł could easily end up at 1,400 zł or more.
would_change_my_mind: If the full bill for about 12 kids with adults' coffee and cake came to more than about 1,300 zł, or if the reviews said the entertainer was just going through the motions, I'd go to the big hall in Gdańsk.
